svg.title: Shinseina Ki — Sacred Heartwood. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Wood classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Hallowed Seed forks into Rooted in Wisdom then Heartwood Awakened. Grasping Roots forks into Rootbound Prey then Judgement of the Grove, or Fangs of Heartwood then The Forest Devours. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu.

60 AP, cooldown 7), two 35% self Increase Damage Given rows on the 40 AP Forest Wisdom cast, and one 35% Increase Damage Taken row on Grove's circle. Its biggest spike comes from those three multipliers compounding (\u00d71.35\u00b3 \u2248 \u00d72.46 on a window hit). Hallowed Seed answers \"How do I make Forest Wisdom's two rounds my strongest window?\" with self amplification of the caster's own Wood, Earth, Water and element-less hits (both rows on the kit's attacks). Grasping Roots answers \"How do I add damage beyond my own Forest Wisdom window: expose the Grove's prey to every attacker, or put more weight on every Wood strike?\" with the exposure route and the burst route, a controlled +2 Damage split +1 on the Hidden Art and +1 on the capstone (the Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura magnitude, not their shape; see above_nuke_rationale). Raw Damage sits apart from the self buff, so no build stacks it on the +6% window. Recoil, poison, wound, summon and visual rows are unsupported, and Wood Warrior Summon (PVP only) carries no supported row. DEBUFF","adverse":false,"base":25.0,"gain":0,"final":25.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["The Forest Devours"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, as before the 2026-10-04 batch. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Damage x3, Increase Damage Given x2 on one cast, Increase Damage Taken x1), so it holds exactly three identities: self amplification (Hallowed Seed \u2192 Rooted in Wisdom \u2192 Heartwood Awakened), exposure (Grasping Roots \u2192 Rootbound Prey \u2192 Judgement of the Grove) and burst (Grasping Roots \u2192 Fangs of Heartwood \u2192 The Forest Devours). A fourth capstone could only repeat one of those tags on the same rows. Universal node accepted: Grasping Roots is in all 8 legal full builds, because Heartwood Awakened's only prerequisite-closed fourth purchase is the other Foundation. A second Hidden Art under Hallowed Seed would be filler: an Increase Damage Given leaf twins Rooted in Wisdom on the same two rows and stacks with Heartwood Awakened, an Increase Damage Taken leaf twins Rootbound Prey, and a Damage leaf twins Fangs of Heartwood and becomes Heartwood Awakened's best fourth, the raw Damage on the compounding window that this layout keeps apart.","design_notes":["Structure: edges 01\u219204\u219205, 06\u219207\u219208 and 06\u219202\u219203. Hallowed Seed +2% / Rooted in Wisdom +1% / Heartwood Awakened +3% Increase Damage Given (route +6%); Grasping Roots +2% / Rootbound Prey +3% / Judgement of the Grove +5% Increase Damage Taken (route +10%); Fangs of Heartwood +1 / The Forest Devours +1 Damage (route +2, on Grasping Roots' +2% exposure). Any two capstones cost 5 or 6 BP. 8 legal full builds: five capstone builds and three without a capstone. Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +6%, Increase Damage Taken +10%, Damage +2.","Roster pass: the first pass of this batch removed flat Damage and shrank the tree to six nodes because any flat Damage lifts Eternal Forest past 50. The burst route is restored at the Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura magnitude (RUL-2026-10-04-001/002), +2 rather than the pre-batch +5 (40 \u2192 45, 50 \u2192 55): Serpent and Grove 40 \u2192 42, Eternal Forest 50 \u2192 52. It now hangs under Grasping Roots instead of Hallowed Seed: under Hallowed Seed, Fangs of Heartwood was Heartwood Awakened's best fourth (+6% Increase Damage Given with +1 Damage, \u00d72.75 on a window hit and the strongest duel opener of any build), because raw Damage and the compounding self buff multiply each other. Fangs of Heartwood is a +1 Damage commit (Terra Nova shape), not the precedent's percentage setup, because both percentage setups fail here: +1% Increase Damage Given (all +2 on The Forest Devours) makes Hallowed Seed the burst route's dominant fourth, and +1% Increase Damage Taken twins Rootbound Prey and puts Judgement of the Grove + Fangs of Heartwood at +11%, over the 10% ceiling (above_nuke_rationale).","Why the printed totals differ: every Increase Damage Given point lands on both Forest Wisdom rows, which compound, so the +6% route is \u00d7(1.41/1.35)\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d71.09 on own hits in the window; the +10% exposure route is \u00d71.45/1.35 \u2248 \u00d71.07 on every attacker's hits on the caught enemies; the +2 Damage route is \u00d71.05 (\u00d71.04 on Eternal Forest) on every Wood cast, in or out of a window. Duel opener (Forest Wisdom and Grove in round 1, Serpent and Eternal Forest in rounds 2 and 3) against the unmodified kit: Heartwood Awakened + Grasping Roots \u00d71.091, Judgement of the Grove + Hallowed Seed \u00d71.090, The Forest Devours + Hallowed Seed \u00d71.085. Burst leads on every Wood strike outside the windows (\u00d71.05 against \u00d71.00), self amplification on own hits away from the circle, exposure on allies' hits.","No-capstone builds (01, 02, 06, 07; 01, 02, 04, 06; 01, 04, 06, 07) are weaker in every situation (window hit in the circle, own hit away from it, hit outside the windows, allies' hits) than the capstone build suited to that situation; they exist only because the structure allows them.","Fourth purchases: Heartwood Awakened takes Grasping Roots only. Judgement of the Grove takes Hallowed Seed (duel) or Fangs of Heartwood (41 / 41 / 51 EP; better only on Wood strikes outside the Forest Wisdom window). The Forest Devours takes Hallowed Seed (solo) or Rootbound Prey (exposure 40%, team).","Interactions (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73/\u00a73b): Forest Wisdom row 0 (no element, Highest filter) matches the kit's Wood hits, every element-less hit of any stat and elemental hits of the caster's highest stat; row 1 (Earth/None/Water/Wood) matches those elements. Matching rows each multiply the hit, and Grove's exposure multiplies again; the bloodline passive (25+0.15/level, Wood/Earth/Water/None) multiplies last. Formula damage is linear in EP (tags.ts powerEffect 1436\u20131461), so +2 EP is \u00d742/40 on a 40 row before every multiplier.","Delivery and timing: cooldown 7 on every jutsu; buff and debuff rows act only in the two rounds after their cast. Forest Wisdom (40 AP, SELF) and Grove (60 AP, radius-1 circle on an OTHER_USER target, range 4) fit one round, so Serpent and Eternal Forest land in the shared window; Grove's exposure never amplifies its own hit, and in that opener only the burst route raises it."],"risks":["Classification: Wood is the single qualifying element; sharing it with Nature's Blessing is expected (RUL-2026-10-03-005). Forest Wisdom row 0 and Grove's exposure carry no element, so they need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver; the three Damage rows carry Wood natively. Wood Warrior Summon carries no Wood row and no supported row. Off-kit Wood coverage (NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN) is unverified.","Damage tier: every build with The Forest Devours lifts Eternal Forest 50 \u2192 52 EP, past the Nuke tier, and Fangs of Heartwood alone gives 51 in three builds without it: Judgement of the Grove + Fangs of Heartwood and the no-capstone 01, 02, 04, 06 and 01, 02, 06, 07 (above_nuke_rationale; director review). Serpent and Grove stop at 42, Normal tier. The +2 reaches every Wood Damage row, so an off-kit Wood row at 45 or 50 would read 47 or 52; the validator enumerates kit rows only.","Stacking: Heartwood Awakened's two Forest Wisdom rows compound with each other and with Grove's exposure (\u00d71.41\u00b2 \u00d7 1.37 \u2248 \u00d72.72 on a window hit in its complete build); Judgement of the Grove's 45% applies to every enemy in the circle and to every attacker's hits, so its team value grows with the number of allies. Not simulated.","Ally hazard: Grove's damage row (friendly fire absent = ALL) and poison row (ALL) hit allies standing in the radius-1 circle at cast time; Fangs of Heartwood and The Forest Devours raise that damage to 41 / 42 EP. The exposure row is ENEMIES only.","Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"01":"How do I make Forest Wisdom's two rounds my strongest window?","06":"How do I add damage beyond my own Forest Wisdom window: expose the Grove's prey to every attacker, or put more weight on every Wood strike?"},"route_identities":{"05":"self amplification: the caster's own Wood, Earth, Water and element-less hits in the Forest Wisdom window (both rows on the kit's attacks and element-less hits)","08":"exposure: the Grove circle multiplies every attacker's hits (team, area)","03":"burst: controlled +2 Damage on every Wood cast, in or out of a window (+1 commit, +1 payoff)"},"director_review":"Two open choices. (1) Above-Nuke Damage outside the payoff: the burst route's +2 is split +1 on Fangs of Heartwood (Hidden Art) and +1 on The Forest Devours, with only Grasping Roots' shared +2% exposure under it, so it does not follow the Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura shape (RUL-2026-10-04-001/002). Eternal Forest reaches 52 with the capstone and 51 without it in three builds: Judgement of the Grove + Fangs of Heartwood (an exposure capstone's 4-BP build) and the no-capstone 01, 02, 04, 06 and 01, 02, 06, 07. The precedent shape makes burst the solo default here (above_nuke_rationale). Confirm 51 outside the payoff, take the precedent shape anyway, or keep Damage unamplified and return the tree to two chains. (2) Judgement of the Grove's +10% single-row area exposure is above the anchors' +5% exposure and should move with the roster's other exposure routes.","concerns":["Heartwood Awakened is held at +6% (Rooted in Wisdom only +1%) because both Forest Wisdom rows compound; at +7% (Rooted in Wisdom +2%, about \u00d71.12 in a duel) self amplification would be the default even in duels. The roster's other two-row Increase Damage Given routes sit at +7\u20138% (R3 allows up to +8%).","With kit attacks Judgement of the Grove ties Heartwood Awakened at best in solo play (\u00d72.72 against \u00d72.72 on a window hit in the circle; \u00d71.88 against \u00d71.99 on own hits away from it). Its edge is allies' hits (\u00d71.45 against \u00d71.37) and off-element own hits in the circle (\u00d71.99 against \u00d71.93). Grove's damage row (friendly fire absent = ALL) and poison row (ALL) hit any ally inside the radius-1 circle at cast time, so the melee allies the exposure route serves must not stand next to the target when Grove is cast. Values left for the director.","Fangs of Heartwood carries flat Damage on a Hidden Art (roster rules R1/R6), so Eternal Forest reaches 51 in three builds without The Forest Devours. It is kept because both percentage commits fail the fourth-BP audit: +1% Increase Damage Given (a cross-Foundation twin of Rooted in Wisdom, all +2 on the capstone) lets Hallowed Seed put +3% on both compounding rows under +2 Damage (duel opener \u00d71.099 against \u00d71.091), and +1% Increase Damage Taken twins Rootbound Prey and reaches +11% with Judgement of the Grove.","The burst route is modest: in a duel opener it trails the other two capstones (\u00d71.085 against \u00d71.09) and leads only on Wood strikes outside the windows (\u00d71.05 against \u00d71.00). Its value is uptime on every cast, not size.","Grasping Roots is a universal node (all 8 legal full builds); see narrow_kit_exception."]},"above_nuke_rationale":"Fable proposal that departs from the director precedent's shape and needs an explicit ruling. Blood-Enchanted Eyes (RUL-2026-10-04-001, Reaper's Embrace 50 \u2192 52) and Shakunetsu Sakura (RUL-2026-10-04-002, Sakura-ame 50 \u2192 52) lift a 50 row only through a controlled +2 Damage payoff on the Advanced Art after a percentage setup on the Hidden Art. Here the burst route's +2 is split, Fangs of Heartwood (Hidden Art) +1 and The Forest Devours +1, and the only percentage under it is Grasping Roots' +2% exposure, which the exposure route shares. Eternal Forest goes 50 \u2192 52 in both builds with The Forest Devours, and 50 \u2192 51 without the payoff in three: Judgement of the Grove + Fangs of Heartwood (06, 07, 08, 02, the exposure capstone's own 4-BP build) and the no-capstone 01, 02, 04, 06 and 01, 02, 06, 07. Exploding Wood Serpent and Guardian's Grove stop at 42, Normal tier; no legal allocation adds more than +2 Damage. The precedent shape was checked and rejected: Fangs of Heartwood +1% Increase Damage Given with The Forest Devours +2 makes Hallowed Seed the burst route's obvious fourth (+3% on both compounding Forest Wisdom rows under +2 Damage; duel opener \u00d71.099 against \u00d71.091 and \u00d71.090, level with Heartwood Awakened on the window's two strikes and \u00d71.05 ahead outside the window), so burst would be the default for any Wood build; a +1% Increase Damage Taken commit twins Rootbound Prey and puts Judgement of the Grove + Fangs of Heartwood at +11%, over the 10% ceiling. The kit's Burst trait and the pre-batch +5 route (Eternal Forest 50 \u2192 55) make burst part of its identity. Pending director review: confirm 51 outside the payoff, take the precedent shape and accept burst as the solo default, or keep Damage unamplified."}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wood jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Judgement of the Grove path + Hallowed Seed
The Forest Devours path + Hallowed Seed
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHINSEINA KI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Wisdom · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance (roster pass) / Wood classification / forked tree
